framework_decision.decision: Build E2 as a CUSTOM METRIC on the harness's own E1 substrate — NO Ragas/DeepEval/PromptFoo dependency. This is the 'DeepEval custom metric' lane realized natively (a custom metric's logic is the author's regardless of framework), preserving the substrate's structural guarantees. decision_description: Delivered E2 status-aware faithfulness: harness/status_faithfulness.py partitions every Tier-5 claim by the engine's own status and judges each against the target that status promises. confirmed -> judged STRICTLY against its source_ref (a confirmed claim its own source does not support is a HARD integrity finding, SEVERITY_INTEGRITY — the 'gap masked as confirmed' no predicate can see). assumed -> judged against the operator-DECLARED VALUE in working_assumptions.json (via the shared runner.working_assumptions reader, by key then checklist_ref), NOT the source (complements the W1 predicate: existence -> content; a mismatch is SEVERITY_CONTENT_DRIFT). inferred -> judged as framing/synthesis under a SOFTER bar (passed OR a low-score pass), a failure being a soft concern (SEVERITY_SOFT). Un-verifiable claims are surfaced, never dropped: an unresolvable source_ref or an assumed claim with no backing declaration -> SEVERITY_UNRESOLVED (judge NOT invoked); an unpartitioned status -> SEVERITY_UNKNOWN_STATUS. Reporting-only; zero DAG runs; built against the current excellence/impact/implementation_section.json and re-points at M2-T10's graph-sourced artifacts unchanged (identical claim schema).

implementation.reuses_substrate: harness.judge.Judge (pinned, non-drafter, temp-0, provenance-logged), harness.routing.assert_judgeable (a claim_id colliding with a deterministic PREDICATE_REGISTRY name is REFUSED — a green judge never overrides a red predicate), harness.verdict.Verdict/MajorityVerdict (typed Inferred, N>=3 majority scaffold), harness.report.build_report (advisory=True, blocking=False by construction), runner.working_assumptions (the shared W1 reader), runner.paths, runner.atomic_write.
implementation.source_resolution: resolve_claim_source_text handles the FULL real source_ref grammar (verified: 406/406 real claim refs across excellence/impact/implementation resolve, 0 unresolved, 0 truncated): a bare path; a path#fragment (fragment = object 'id', e.g. #FELLOW / #IMP-1); a parenthetical hint that names the sub-part (e.g. '(spine_identity FELLOW)'), used to NARROW a whole-file source to the cited object (the FELLOW entry ~842 chars, not the ~6.5KB checklist blob — this also answers the code-review dilution finding); COMPOUND refs citing several sources joined by ' and ' or ';' (depth-aware split that respects separators inside hints); nested-paren hints; and trailing freeform prose after the path (dropped — a piece with no docs/-path is explanation, not a citation). Truncation is LOUD not silent: DEFAULT_MAX_SOURCE_CHARS raised 8000->40000 (above the largest real source) and any overflow is marked, so a finding on a truncated source is legible rather than a fabricated gap (code-review Spec (c) fix).
implementation.bars: Per-status StatusPolicy (comparison target + strict/soft + min_score + fail severity). DEFAULT_POLICIES: confirmed = source/strict/0.90/integrity; inferred = source/soft/0.50/soft; assumed = declared_value/strict/0.90/content_drift. The boolean 'passed' is the PRIMARY signal at every panel size; the numeric score only refines the bar (the confirmed ≈1.0 floor; the inferred score-rescue) when score_informs_decision is True, which callers set ONLY for an N>=3 majority panel — so a single sample's score never drives a hard integrity finding (code-review Spec (a)/(b) fix + the N>=3 guardrail, honoured structurally). Bars are operator policy, not physics (documented as such).
implementation.m3_reuse: freeze_baseline snapshots the per-claim grounding verdict on the pre-composition ledger; compare_to_baseline re-runs on the composed output and flags any claim whose grounding WEAKENED — bar_regression (met->unmet), status_changed, or dropped all BREAK invariance; a score_drop still meeting the bar is a soft, non-breaking flag. 'Form may change, grounding may not.' A baseline is keyed to the judge pin it was frozen under (applies_to); a comparison spanning a repin is flagged (judge_repinned), mirroring the E1.5 calibration discipline.
implementation.n_majority: n=1 (single verdict) or n>=3 (majority, the guardrails' N>=3 rule where a score informs a decision); n=2 is rejected (cannot break a tie).

earn_its_lane_finding: E2 surfaced real signal on the current artifacts in offline testing: with a judge stubbed to mark a confirmed claim unsupported, the metric produces the SEVERITY_INTEGRITY 'gap masked as confirmed' finding a predicate cannot — the exact threat the strategy names — while a green judge yields zero integrity findings. The status partitioning (source vs declared-value vs soft-framing) is the distinct capability: the same-model-family in-run reviewer cannot be the unbiased grader, and no deterministic predicate reaches semantic entailment. This is the recorded Wave-0 decision-gate finding: status-aware faithfulness earns Wave 0 in a single framework (the harness's own substrate). Whether to adopt a SECOND framework in Wave 1 (E4/E5) is a separate gate, evaluated then.

code_review.spec_dispositions: (c) whole-file source dilution + latent 8000-char truncation could manufacture a false integrity finding — ADDRESSED: cap raised to 40000 (above the largest real source), truncation made loud, and hint-narrowing added so a whole-file checklist cite is judged against just the cited object. (a)/(b) a single-sample score informing a hard decision violates the N>=3 guardrail and the ≈1.0 floor was void when score absent — ADDRESSED: score refines the bar only when score_informs_decision (set only for N>=3), boolean-primary otherwise. Real-data probe additionally surfaced (beyond both reviews) that the resolver did not handle compound/prose refs — FIXED (0/406 unresolved). Scope-creep items (claim_filter, score-drop tolerance, baseline write/load, unresolved/unknown surfacing) judged defensible/aligned with fail-closed intent — kept.
